annotations.title: Owner operator rate floor and take home

description: Find the lowest rate per loaded mile that covers your costs and your take-home, and what you take home at your current rate. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

currentRate.description: Your average rate per loaded mile (all-in). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

deadhead.description: Empty-mile share. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

fuelPrice.description: Diesel price. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

mpg.description: Fuel economy. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

otherCpm.description: Other cost per mile (tires, maintenance, reserves). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

takeHome.description: Take-home you need per week, before income tax. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

weeklyFixed.description: Fixed costs per week (truck payment, insurance, permits, ELD, phone). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

weeklyMiles.description: Total miles per week. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

weeks.description: Weeks worked per year. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.
